regime.label: Cautious, no panic
regime.summary: Mon: S&P 500 -1.9%, Nasdaq -2.5%, VIX closed 23.7. Tue: S&P futures about flat, Stoxx 600 -0.9% on new US chip curbs and a Deutsche Bank leak. Retail sales +0.2% as expected. 10-year 5.12%.

brief: Markets are nervous but not in panic before Nvidia's results tonight (01:20 Dubai): S&P futures flat, VIX near 23. Today: sell CBRS if the stop did not trigger, keep the Richemont CHF 170 limit, no new AI, index or lab buy before Wednesday.

todo.focus: Nvidia results tonight (~01:20 Dubai). Prepare, don't bet.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at CHF 170, valid until Fri Nov 27. Now about CHF 173.70. Keep the limit, do not chase; never pay above CHF 175.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia results Tue (call 02:00 Dubai Wed)
cards.trigger: HOLD. No new AI buy before the numbers. Act Wed after 19:00 Dubai using the playbook.
cards.story: Options price a move of about 8.8%. First report since the CEO resigned; the risk is the reaction, not the numbers.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: WAIT for Nvidia results. From Wed Nov 18: BUY 6 with a limit at $87.00 (Mon close $87.11), valid until Fri Nov 20. Then 6 more each week below $91.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. 5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit likely filled Monday (closed $283.72). If not filled, it stays valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled; 31% below its high. Also benefits from the Anthropic IPO (Nov 19).

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: Mon close $373.45, under the $385 floor. From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 at a $395 limit only if TSM closes back above $385 first.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%. Mostly chip-sector mood, but TSMC is prudent on 2027 and new US chip rules touch it.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 10 with a limit at EUR 48.50 if IFX holds above EUR 46. Now about EUR 49.29.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips; 45% below its high. Growth leans on one segment.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 with a limit at $335, only if ETN holds above $327. Mon close $336.88.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), guidance raised, but debt doubled and data-center policy risk is real.

cards.name: Global Payments
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $86, valid until Fri Nov 20. Mon close $89.87.
cards.story: -12% when buyout talks ended: buyers could not finance a deal. Cheap at about 6.5x profit, so buy only lower.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT for a dip: BUY 2 with a limit at EUR 235 (now about EUR 240).
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal and a Middle East warning, not demand.

cards.name: Deutsche Bank
cards.trigger: WATCH only. No buy before Mon Nov 23. Then reconsider only if no regulator (BaFin, ECB, DOJ) opens a new probe.
cards.story: About -5% after a leak of 15 million old files. Profits untouched, but fines or probes could follow.

cards.name: Luxury selloff: Hermes, Kering
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy on Hermes or Kering. Hermes: only if China sales stop falling (Feb 2027). Kering: only if Gucci stops shrinking.
cards.story: Hermes -4.3% with no company news, still about 29x profit for about 10% growth. Mixed, not mood.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, ServiceNow
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Salesforce results Wed Dec 2. From Fri Dec 4: reconsider 2 CRM below $215 if organic growth holds and no guide is cut.
cards.story: Salesforce 20% and ServiceNow 43% below their highs. Without acquisitions Salesforce grows only about 6-7%.

cards.name: Alstom · Paris
cards.trigger: AVOID. No buy, even after the H1 release tonight (about 21:00 Dubai). Recheck only once a funding plan is clear.
cards.story: Cut profit and cash goals twice in 2026; a share sale may follow. Cheap is not the same as a buy.
